teaching_point: Asteatotic eczema (eczema craquelé): dry, fissured 'crazy-paving' pattern on the shins of an older adult — worse in winter/low humidity; emollient + soap substitute are the cornerstone.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Eczema craquelé (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/asteatotic-eczema

teaching_point: Eczema craquelé close-up: shallow red fissures between polygonal plates of scale — short course of moderate topical steroid plus generous emollient.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Eczema craquelé (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/asteatotic-eczema

teaching_point: More extensive asteatotic eczema — review drugs that dry skin (diuretics, statins, retinoids) and bathing habits (hot water, soap).
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Eczema craquelé (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/asteatotic-eczema

teaching_point: Dermatitis arising from very dry skin — xerosis is the commonest cause of itch in older people.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Dermatitis from dry skin (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/dry-skin

teaching_point: Winter itch: excoriations on dry skin with little primary rash — think xerosis first, then systemic causes if it persists.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Winter itch — excoriations (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/winter-itch

teaching_point: Chronic pruritus: linear excoriations and bruising from scratching with no primary eruption — triggers a systematic dermatological/systemic/psychological work-up.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Excoriations and bruises (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/pruritus

teaching_point: Venous (stasis/gravitational) eczema: lower-leg eczema with haemosiderin staining over varicose veins — key leg-rash differential; treat venous hypertension (compression after ABPI).
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Venous eczema (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/venous-eczema

teaching_point: Lipodermatosclerosis: indurated 'inverted champagne bottle' lower leg from chronic venous disease — often mistaken for bilateral cellulitis.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Lipodermatosclerosis (© Te Whatu Ora) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/venous-eczema

teaching_point: Discoid (nummular) eczema: coin-shaped itchy plaques on limbs — differential for elderly leg rash; often needs potent steroid and emollient.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Discoid eczema (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-eczema

teaching_point: Lichen simplex chronicus on the lateral shin: thickened, lichenified plaque from repeated rubbing — break the itch–scratch cycle.
dermnet_caption: Localised lichen simplex on the lateral shin - a common area for this disorder
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Localised lichen simplex on the lateral shin - a common area for this disorder (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/lichen-simplex

teaching_point: Lichen simplex on the ankles in skin of colour: accentuated skin markings, scale and hyperpigmentation.
dermnet_caption: Lichen simplex on the ankles - accentuated skin markings, scale and pigmentation in skin of colour
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Lichen simplex on the ankles - accentuated skin markings, scale and pigmentation in skin of colour (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/lichen-simplex

teaching_point: Lichen simplex plaque — potent/very potent steroid (± occlusion) and habit reversal; look for an underlying itchy dermatosis.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Lichen simplex (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/lichen-simplex

teaching_point: Nodular prurigo: excoriated firm papules/nodules in accessible sites — end-stage of chronic scratching; screen for systemic itch causes.
dermnet_caption: Excoriated papules on the arms in nodular prurigo
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Excoriated papules on the arms in nodular prurigo (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/nodular-prurigo

teaching_point: Brachioradial pruritus: lichenification on sun-exposed outer forearm — neuropathic itch (cervical spine/UV) in older adults.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Brachioradial pruritus — lichenification from scratching (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/brachioradial-pruritus

teaching_point: Numerous palmar burrows in an elderly woman — always exclude scabies in new itch, especially care-home residents.
dermnet_caption: Numerous palmar scabies burrows in an elderly lady
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Numerous palmar scabies burrows in an elderly lady (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/scabies

teaching_point: Crusted (Norwegian) scabies in an elderly woman: thick crusted plaques, often little itch — highly contagious; outbreak management and specialist input.
dermnet_caption: Thick crusted plaques on the thumb and palm due to crusted scabies in an elderly woman
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Thick crusted plaques on the thumb and palm due to crusted scabies in an elderly woman (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/scabies

teaching_point: Bullous pemphigoid: tense blisters on an urticated base in an older adult — itch can precede blisters for months; refer (biopsy/specialist).
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Bullous pemphigoid (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/bullous-pemphigoid

teaching_point: Actinic (senile/Bateman) purpura: irregular dark-red/purple ecchymoses on thin, sun-damaged forearms after trivial trauma — check anticoagulant/antiplatelet/steroid use.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Senile purpura (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/senile-purpura

teaching_point: Actinic purpura on the dorsal hand leaving brown haemosiderin staining — benign, but a marker of dermatoporosis.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Senile purpura (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/senile-purpura

teaching_point: More extensive actinic purpura — consider FBC/clotting only if purpura is in non-exposed sites, mucosal bleeding or systemic symptoms.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Senile purpura (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/senile-purpura

teaching_point: Thin, translucent ('cigarette-paper') skin — dermal atrophy of chronological + photo-ageing (dermatoporosis stage I).
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Thin skin (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/ageing-skin

teaching_point: Skin fragility with tearing after minor trauma — dermatoporosis: protect limbs, avoid adhesive dressings, refer skin tears to nurse-led wound care.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Skin fragility (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/ageing-skin

teaching_point: Stellate pseudoscars: white star-shaped scars on forearms — classic sign of dermatoporosis alongside actinic purpura.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Stellate pseudoscars (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/ageing-skin

teaching_point: Steroid purpura: long-term topical/oral corticosteroid accelerates dermal atrophy and bruising — a drug-history prompt.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Steroid purpura (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/purpura

teaching_point: Actinic keratosis on the nasal bridge: pink base with adherent hyperkeratotic scale — often better felt (sandpaper) than seen.
dermnet_caption: A pink base with a hyperkeratotic top on the nasal bridge - a common site for actinic keratoses
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — A pink base with a hyperkeratotic top on the nasal bridge - a common site for actinic keratoses (© Raimo Suhonen) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/actinic-keratosis

teaching_point: AK on the nose — sun-exposed site; treat with 5-FU, diclofenac 3%, tirbanibulin or cryotherapy per PCDS pathway.
dermnet_caption: An actinic keratosis on the nose
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — An actinic keratosis on the nose (© Te Whatu Ora) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/actinic-keratosis

teaching_point: Field change on the forehead with multiple superficial AKs — field treatment rather than lesion-by-lesion.
dermnet_caption: Field change over the forehead with multiple superficial actinic keratoses
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Field change over the forehead with multiple superficial actinic keratoses (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/actinic-keratosis

teaching_point: Hyperkeratotic AKs on the forehead — thick lesions may need Actikerall/cryotherapy; tender/indurated = suspect SCC (2WW).
dermnet_caption: Hyperkeratotic actinic keratoses on the forehead
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Hyperkeratotic actinic keratoses on the forehead (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/actinic-keratosis

teaching_point: Thicker AKs on the dorsal hand — common site; low threshold to refer if tender, bleeding or rapidly growing.
dermnet_caption: Thicker actinic keratoses on the dorsal hand
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Thicker actinic keratoses on the dorsal hand (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/actinic-keratosis

teaching_point: Actinic cheilitis: scaly, blurred vermilion border of the lower lip — AK of the lip; higher SCC risk, usually refer.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Actinic cheilitis (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/actinic-cheilitis

teaching_point: Seborrhoeic keratosis: warty 'stuck-on' brown papule — the likely diagnosis for the Week 4 case's slowly enlarging pigmented scalp growths (familial).
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Seborrhoeic keratosis (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/seborrhoeic-keratosis

teaching_point: Pigmented seborrhoeic keratosis — benign; reassure; dermoscopy/refer if any melanoma features.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Pigmented seborrhoeic keratosis (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/seborrhoeic-keratosis

teaching_point: Atrophic photoageing: thin, telangiectatic, smoother skin with lentigines and keratoses — higher keratinocyte cancer risk.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Atrophic photoageing (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/ageing-skin

teaching_point: Hypertrophic photoageing: thick, leathery, coarsely wrinkled sallow skin — dermatoheliosis with solar elastosis.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Hypertrophic photoageing (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/ageing-skin

teaching_point: Solar elastosis: yellowish, thickened, furrowed skin from accumulated abnormal elastic tissue in chronically sun-exposed skin.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Solar elastosis (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/solar-elastosis

teaching_point: Yellow papules/plaques of solar elastosis on the nose — DDx sebaceous hyperplasia, BCC.
dermnet_caption: Yellow lesions of solar elastosis on the nose
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Yellow lesions of solar elastosis on the nose (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/solar-elastosis

teaching_point: Favre–Racouchot syndrome: solar elastosis with large open comedones and cysts around the eyes/temples — sun + smoking.
dermnet_caption: Favre-Racouchot syndrome showing elastosis and solar comedones and cysts
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Favre-Racouchot syndrome showing elastosis and solar comedones and cysts (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/solar-elastosis

teaching_point: Solar (senile) comedones on the upper cheek — topical retinoid, comedone extraction; sun protection and smoking cessation.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Solar comedones (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/solar-comedo

teaching_point: Cutis rhomboidalis nuchae: deep criss-cross furrows on the back of the neck from chronic UV — 'farmer's/sailor's neck'.
dermnet_caption: Cutis rhomboidalis nuchae often seen in association with Favre Racouchot syndrome
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Cutis rhomboidalis nuchae often seen in association with Favre Racouchot syndrome (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/solar-comedo

teaching_point: Idiopathic guttate hypomelanosis: small porcelain-white macules on sun-exposed shins/forearms — benign, reassure; DDx vitiligo, pityriasis versicolor.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Idiopathic guttate hypomelanosis (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/idiopathic-guttate-hypomelanosis

teaching_point: IGH close-up: sharply defined porcelain-white patch — cosmetic only; camouflage + photoprotection.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Porcelain-white patch extending peripherally (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/idiopathic-guttate-hypomelanosis

teaching_point: Poikiloderma of Civatte: reddish-brown reticulate pigmentation with telangiectasia on the sides of the neck, sparing the shaded area under the chin.

attribution: Image: DermNet — Poikiloderma of Civatte (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/poikiloderma-of-civatte

teaching_point: Poikiloderma of Civatte — atrophy + pigment + telangiectasia; photoprotection, stop photosensitising fragrance; IPL/vascular laser cosmetically.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Poikiloderma of Civatte (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/poikiloderma-of-civatte

teaching_point: Facial telangiectases in photo-aged skin — IPL/vascular laser are cosmetic options (Week 5 link).
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Telangiectases (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/ageing-skin

teaching_point: Smoking-related skin ageing: deep wrinkles and grey sallow skin — smoking cessation is primary prevention of skin ageing.
dermnet_caption: Smoking and its effects on the skin — wrinkling
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)

teaching_point: Cherry angiomas (Campbell de Morgan spots): benign bright-red papules increasing with age — reassure.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Cherry angiomas (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/cherry-angioma

teaching_point: Sebaceous hyperplasia: yellowish umbilicated papules on the face — key mimic of BCC in older skin.
